Hello @everyone ! 

After this exciting FFA tournament, we have the pleasure to open our clan tournament : the Clan War League !
For the first CWL season starting tomorrow, 21 teams have registered, so we built 3 divisions.

You can see the division sheets below, where you can find the complete schedule, the results and leaderboards of each division.
Division 1 (Bowser): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1e-hUQcyxTZbY1A_p6ZnHP-Q-ukGpy9sQeDULwqdLLe4/

Your Division Managers will be:
Division 1: @TromTendo 
Division 2: @Colin
Division 3: @LabatM  @Cobra 

We also build little team profiles for each time which will be updated as the league is running. In order to insert a team logo, please open a ticket in ⁠unknown!

The very first matches are starting tomorrow, so be ready to fight ! 
Every team captain will have to join ⁠unknown channel 30min before the starting time, to set up the match.
We are super excited for you and your teams to be able to compete in this competition, and following it within division sheets, let's now get wars started !

If you have any questions, please feel free to ask a staff member!

Thank you for your support,
Your MKT Competitive Staff

Hello @everyone!

The first Mario Kart Tour tournament has completed. The staff at Mario Kart Tour Competitive are very thankful for everyone who participate and made this happen. We are extremely grateful to have been part of the first Mario Kart Tour tournament and have it run as well as it did.

We especially want to congratulate Antumbra for going undefeated in the tournament and winning! Very well done, and congratulations to them.
We also want to congratulate @Danny for getting the most points in the entire tournament. Well done for this individual accomplishment!

To view all the final leaderboard, results and individual accomplishments you can follow this link:
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1VX_OlQzXPVTgVpNpnyhz0K2tVS_--f73-QgHhELqJw0/

As you may well know, we had many people try and predict who has won. You can see the results of this in the sheet above on the last page! We had many great predictions (and some bad ones  ).

-----

Looking forward, we have an exciting upcoming week with the All-Stars match happening on April 5th, 2020 18:00 (CET). Your team captains will vote on who they think deserve to be in the All-Star match. For the captains, please allow yourself enough time to vote and read the rules. The voting is due this upcoming Tuesday in order to give us enough time to plan.
For captains only, here is the voting sheet for performances in the this tournament:
https://forms.gle/133oQgUGxyT5CjYy9

NOTE: You can use page 2 of the previously mentioned document in order to sway your voting.

------

We are also excited to announce that with this tournament running so smoothly, we will start the big league system. The CWL (Clan War League) is planned to launch on April 12th, 2020. The registration phase will begin very shortly after the voting for All-Stars finishes.

Thank you very much for competing,
Your MKT-Competitive Staff
